275cc Smooth Round Implants

Breast Augmentation Mammoplasty

Case Details: Dr Eddie Cheng (Surgeon) – This lady presented with a small A cup breast and was hoping to achieve around a B cup. She is 168 cm tall and 55 kg weight. Dr Eddie Cheng performed a bilateral breast augmentation mammoplasty with Bilateral Fat transfer using 275 cc smooth round implants. She is now 5 months post op under the care of Dr Eddie Cheng.
